meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把视频里的配乐与旁白混合好,做淡入淡出、音量自动压低与音效处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里的背景音乐盖住了人声,想快速把两条音轨混好。
copy.tagline_en: Mix music and voiceover in your video with fades, ducking, and track effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if background music drowns out the voiceover and you need them balanced.

howto.what: 对已经放进 HyperFrames 合成里的音频做混音:写入 data-fx-chain 效果链(均衡、压缩、限幅、混响等)、data-automation 自动化包络,以及用 data-fx-carve 让音乐床给旁白让路,最终渲染出处理后的 WAV 混音。
howto.when: 当已放置的音频需要混音时触发:淡入淡出、交叉淡化、音量自动化、旁白挖坑、效果链等。不负责找 BGM/SFX 或生成旁白(/media-use),也不管剪辑时序(/hyperframes-core)。

say.text: 把音乐床对着 voiceover 组挖个坑,让旁白听得清
say.note: 会给音乐床写 data-fx-carve 和对应自动化包络

say.text: 给这条轨道加 80Hz 高通和限幅器,按顺序排好
say.note: 写入 data-fx-chain,预览与渲染共用同一实现

say.text: 在音乐音量上画一条包络,旁白进来时自动降下来
say.note: 写入 data-automation 的音量轨

howto.what_en: Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: it writes data-fx-chain effect chains, automation lanes, and data-fx-carve ducking so a music bed yields to a voiceover, then renders a processed WAV mix.
howto.when_en: Triggers when placed audio needs mixing: fades, crossfades, volume automation, voiceover carve, effect chains, audio groups. Not for sourcing or generating audio (/media-use) or clip timing (/hyperframes-core).

say_en.text: Carve the music bed against the voiceover group so the voice cuts through
say_en.note: Writes data-fx-carve on the bed plus its automation lanes

say_en.text: Add an 80 Hz highpass and a limiter to this track, in order
say_en.note: Writes data-fx-chain; preview and render share one implementation

say_en.text: Draw a volume envelope on the music that ducks when the voice comes in
say_en.note: Writes a lane on this track's data-automation volume
